observations: Role 562 dispatches 16 domestic furniture kinds using the interior specification size; unsupported kinds return a missing-recipe error. Roles 563–567 and 569 use that envelope and fixed offsets to produce beds and bedding, cabinets, seating, tables, and washing furniture. Whether every derived dimension and normalization is admitted depends on the specification ranges and builder paths, which remain open.

Role 563 builds cushion meshes from normalized cross products and supplies separate central support colliders; a degenerate outline could affect normals, but this read establishes neither an admissible degenerate key nor a product failure. Role 569 derives a tub floor using a radius division and square root; actual radius admission and finite-output guarantees still need tracing.

Role 568 contains source tests for domestic envelopes, contacts, the lectern support and open interiors. The test bodies were read only: their assertions and all 16 kinds or variants have not been executed, and those tests do not by themselves establish admission for other keys or consumer behavior.

Role 570 partitions boards by a count derived from size.z, and constructs worn mesh faces using normalized cross products. Nonpositive or degenerate values and the mesh-only path require separate source tracing before stating reachability or a defect; normal placement dimensions and intentional render/collision approximations must also be distinguished.
No furniture recipe, product build, test, simulation, rendering or runtime probe ran.
remaining: Trace FurnitureKey and interior specification admission, builder mesh and collider paths, per-instance placement, render and physics consumers, and all historical aliases. Independently assess all other lenses.
